blocks.text: Maddi ajsam ki sab mumkina harkaton mein dairawi harkat (circular motion) woh hai jo qudrati duniya ke zyada tar hisse mein kaam karti nazar aati hai: Zameen ke gird dairawi madaron (orbits) mein chalte satellites, khud Zameen ki madari aur gardishi harkat, mure raste par murti car, aur dori se ghumaya patthar maanoos misalein hain. Jab cheezein dairawi raston par chalti hain to un ki simt lagatar badalti hai; chunke velocity vector quantity hai, simt ki yeh tabdeeli ka matlab hai ke un ki velocities mustaqil nahi. Yeh chapter dairawi harkat, gardishi harkat (rotational motion), moment of inertia, angular momentum aur mutalliqa topics parhta hai.

blocks.title: Radian
blocks.text: Daire ke markaz O par arc AB se bana zawiya lein (Fig. 3.1). Agar arc AB ki lambai daire ke radius r ke barabar ho to zawiya ek radian kehlata hai. Yeh zawiyai paimaish ka SI unit hai aur us ka symbol rad hai.

Radius r ke dairawi raste par chalte mass m ke ek zarre P ko lein, jo lambai r ki be-wazan sakht chhari ke sire par laga hai jis ka doosra sira markaz O par pivoted hai (Fig. 3.2a). Jaise zarra daire par chalta hai chhari OP daire ki satah mein ghoomti hai; gardish ka axis pivot O se guzarta hai aur gardish ki satah par amood hai. z-axis ko gardish ke axis ke saath O ko asal maan kar, aur x- aur y-axes gardish ki satah mein lein (Fig. 3.2b). Lamhe t par OP ki jagah OP1 ho jo x-axis se zawiya theta banati hai; baad ke waqt t + delta t par woh OP2 ho jo zawiya theta + delta theta banati hai (Fig. 3.2c).

blocks.title: Angular displacement
blocks.text: Zawiya delta theta waqt delta t mein OP ki angular displacement bayan karta hai. Delta theta ki bohat chhoti qeematon ke liye angular displacement vector quantity hai. Jab OP ki gardish ka rukh counter-clockwise ho to ise musbat nishan diya jata hai. Us ki simt gardish ke axis ke saath hai aur right-hand rule se milti hai (Fig. 3.2d): gardish ke axis ko daen haath mein yun pakrein ke ungliyan gardish ki simt mein murein; angootha angular displacement ki simt batata hai.

Angular displacement ke liye aam taur par teen units istemal hote hain: degrees, revolution aur radian. Radius r ke daire ke lambai S ke arc (Fig. 3.3) ke liye jo markaz par zawiya theta banata hai, radians mein us ki qeemat theta = S/r hai, ya S = r theta (jahan theta radian mein ho) ... (3.1). Agar OP ghoome to nuqta P ek revolution mein faasla S = 2 pi r tay karta hai, jo radians mein S/r = 2 pi r / r = 2 pi hai; to 1 revolution = 2 pi rad = 360 degrees, ya 1 rad = 360/(2 pi) = 57.3 degrees.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: markaz O, radius OA aur radius ke barabar arc AB wala daira, ek radian dikhata hua. Oopar darmiyan: x-y axes par do jagahon P1 aur P2 par chhari OP angular displacement delta theta ke saath. Oopar daen: z-axis se faasle r par nuqta P, axis ke saath omega aur tangential velocity v. Neeche: angular velocity aur acceleration ki tareefein, linear aur angular equations saath saath, aur Example 3.1.
blocks.caption: Zawiyai paimaishein: radian, angular displacement, velocity aur acceleration (Figures 3.1 se 3.5 aur topic 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Radius ke barabar lambai ka arc markaz par ek radian banata hai, to radians mein zawiya arc taqseem radius hai aur poora chakkar do pi radian. Markaz par pivoted chhari jo thore waqt mein chhote zawiye se ghoome us zawiye ko apni angular displacement rakhti hai, jo counter-clockwise musbat aur right-hand rule se axis ke saath hai. Angular velocity angular displacement ki raftar hai aur angular acceleration angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki raftar, dono axis ke saath. Axis se faasle r par nuqta tangent ke saath r zarb angular velocity ki speed se chalta hai aur us ka tangential acceleration r zarb angular acceleration hai, to linear harkat ki equations displacement, velocity aur acceleration ki jagah zawiya, angular velocity aur angular acceleration rakh kar angular harkat par lagti hain, basharte axis fixed ho.

blocks.text: Aksar hum jaanna chahte hain ke jism kitna tez ya sust ghoom raha hai; yeh us ki angular velocity se tay hota hai, jo angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki raftar hai. Fig. 3.2c ke hawale se, agar waqt delta t mein angular displacement delta theta ho to is wuqfe mein ausat angular velocity omega_av = delta theta / delta t ... (3.2). Lamhati (instantaneous) angular velocity omega nisbat delta theta / delta t ki had hai jab delta t sifr ki taraf jaye: omega = lim (delta t -> 0) delta theta / delta t ... (3.3). Is had mein angular displacement be-intiha chhoti hai, to woh vector quantity hai aur Eq. 3.3 se bayan angular velocity bhi vector hai, jis ki simt right-hand rule se gardish ke axis ke saath hai. Angular velocity radians per second mein napi jati hai, jo SI unit hai; kabhi yeh revolutions per minute (rpm) mein bhi di jati hai.

Jab hum bijli ka pankha chalate hain to us ki angular velocity barhti jati hai: us mein angular acceleration hai, jo angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki raftar ke taur par bayan hota hai. Agar omega_i aur omega_f ghoomte jism ki lamhon t_i aur t_f par lamhati angular velocities hon to wuqfe t_f - t_i mein ausat angular acceleration alpha_av = (omega_f - omega_i)/(t_f - t_i) = delta omega / delta t ... (3.4). Lamhati angular acceleration nisbat delta omega / delta t ki had hai jab delta t sifr ki taraf jaye: alpha = lim (delta t -> 0) delta omega / delta t ... (3.5). Angular acceleration bhi vector hai, jis ki miqdar Eq. 3.5 se aur simt gardish ke axis ke saath hai; yeh rad s^-2 mein likha jata hai.

Ab tak hum ne ghoomti be-wazan chhari ke sire par lage zarre P ko dekha. Ab sakht jism (rigid body) ki gardish lein (Fig. 3.4): jism par nuqta P sochein aur OP woh amood ho jo P se gardish ke axis par giraya gaya hai, jise reference line kehte hain. Jaise jism ghoomta hai OP bhi usi angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai, to sakht jism ki gardish us ki reference line ki gardish se bayan hoti hai, aur ghoomti lakeer OP ki madad se bayan sab istilahein sakht jism ki gardishi harkat ke liye bhi durust hain.
Angular aur linear velocities ka taalluq

z-axis ke gird angular velocity omega se ghoomta sakht jism lein (Fig. 3.5a), aur jism mein axis se amood faasle r par nuqta P, OP reference line ho. Jaise jism ghoomta hai P radius r ke daire par linear velocity v se chalta hai jabke OP angular velocity omega se ghoomti hai (Fig. 3.5b). Chunke axis fixed hai, omega ki simt hamesha wahi rehti hai aur omega ko scalar ki tarah sambhala ja sakta hai; P ki linear velocity ke liye hum sirf us ki miqdar lete hain, jo scalar ki tarah bhi sambhali jati hai. Farz karein P waqt delta t mein faasla P1P2 = delta S tay karta hai jabke OP angular displacement delta theta radian tay karti hai; Eq. 3.1 se delta S = r delta theta. Dono taraf delta t se taqseem karne par delta S / delta t = r delta theta / delta t ... (3.6). Had delta t -> 0 mein nisbat delta S / delta t v hai, woh velocity jis se P daire ke gird chalta hai, aur delta theta / delta t OP ki angular velocity omega, to v = r omega ... (3.7). Had mein arc P1P2 bohat chhota ho jata hai aur us ki simt P1 par daire ki tangent hai: P ki velocity ki miqdar v hai aur simt hamesha us nuqte par tangent ke saath, is liye P ki linear velocity tangential velocity bhi kehlati hai. Isi tarah agar OP angular acceleration alpha se ghoome to P ka linear ya tangential acceleration a_t hota hai, aur Eq. 3.7 se dikhaya ja sakta hai ke a_t = r alpha ... (3.8). Equations 3.7 aur 3.8 dikhati hain ke ghoomte jism par axis se mukhtalif faaslon ke nuqton ki speed ya acceleration ek jaisi nahi, magar fixed axis ke gird ghoomte sakht jism ke sab nuqton ki kisi bhi lamhe angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration ek jaisi hai; to angular variables poore jism ki harkat saadgi se bayan karte hain. Zawiya theta ghoomta pahiya tangential faasla S = r theta tay karta hai (Do You Know).

Angular harkat ki equations 3.2 se 3.5 linear harkat ki equations ke bilkul mutabiq hain agar theta, omega aur alpha, S, v aur a ki jagah lein. Chunke linear harkat ki baqi equations in equations ke algebraic radd-o-badal se mili thin, mutabiq equations angular harkat par bhi lagti hain.
Angular equations 3.9 se 3.11 sirf tab durust hain jab gardish ka axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki simt ek jaisi ho aur unhen scalars ki tarah sambhala ja sake.

blocks.title: Example 3.1
blocks.text: 3 rev s^-1 se ghoomta bijli ka pankha band kiya jata hai aur 18.0 s mein ruk jata hai. Deceleration yaksan maan kar us ki qeemat, aur rukne se pehle ki revolutions ki tadaad nikalein. Hal: omega_i = 3.0 rev s^-1, omega_f = 0, t = 18.0 s, alpha = ?, theta = ?. Eq. 3.9 se alpha = (omega_f - omega_i)/t = (0 - 3.0) rev s^-1 / 18.0 s = -0.167 rev s^-2. Eq. 3.11 se theta = omega_i t + (1/2) alpha t^2 = 3.0 rev s^-1 x 18.0 s + (1/2)(-0.167 rev s^-2)(18.0 s)^2 = 27 rev.

blocks.prompt: 108 km h^-1 se chalti car ke pahiyon ka diameter 60 cm hai; pahiye ki angular speed rad s^-1 aur rev s^-1 mein nikalein. 1800 rev min^-1 par chalti motor band ki jati hai aur 20 s mein yaksan taur par rukti hai; woh kitni revolutions karti hai (numerical problems 3.2, 3.3)?
blocks.explanation: v = 108 km h^-1 = 30 m s^-1 aur r = 0.30 m, to omega = v/r = 100 rad s^-1 = 100/(2 pi) = 16 rev s^-1. Motor ke liye omega_i = 1800 rev min^-1 = 30 rev s^-1, omega_f = 0, t = 20 s: alpha = -30/20 = -1.5 rev s^-2 aur theta = 30 x 20 + (1/2)(-1.5)(400) = 600 - 300 = 300 rev.

items: 1 rad: arc = radius; theta = S/r, S = r theta; 1 rev = 2 pi rad = 360 degrees, 1 rad = 57.3 degrees. Angular displacement delta theta vector hai (chhote zawiye), counter-clockwise musbat, simt right-hand rule se axis ke saath.

omega = delta theta / delta t (rad s^-1, rpm), alpha = delta omega / delta t (rad s^-2), dono axis ke saath; v = r omega, a_t = r alpha; velocity tangent ke saath. Angular equations: omega_f = omega_i + alpha t; 2 alpha theta = omega_f^2 - omega_i^2; theta = omega_i t + (1/2) alpha t^2, fixed axis ke liye. Example 3.1: -0.167 rev s^-2, 27 rev.
